title: Independent forced Drive queue lifecycle review
status: Final source and test review completed. No product changes by reviewer.
scope: Read-only review and static IDA evidence; no product source changes, live game/UI actions or game memory writes.

reviewedSources.status: Reviewed heartbeat/reset routing and fresh MakeTrainerContext after DriveTick
Full test source and transition matrix reviewed after author freeze

conclusion: No remaining substantial lifecycle flaw found in the frozen source delta. Two concrete draft findings were fixed. Author reports 685 synthetic checks passing without warnings; the reviewer verified source, test assertions and hashes but did not perform a parallel build, per root coordination.

findings.title: Foreign native transition could be followed by a trainer-owned second step
findings.original: Queue remembered the source actor but not the native context it had queued. Native40CAA0 explicitly cancels/replaces an existing context; waiting for any nonzero global to clear could follow another owner's transition.
findings.resolution: Begin captures nativeContext,sourceActor,nativeForm,nativeTask. Tick rejects mismatched context address or fields before continuing. Full40D000/40CF20/40CC00 review confirms source+0,form+8,task+40 remain stable during normal native processing.

findings.title: Observed pending scene transition could be forgotten while waiting
findings.original: SameScene did not reject9BA928 until later LiveScene validation. A pending transition set and cleared while the native task ran would not cancel the trainer queue.
findings.resolution: SameScene rejects pending transition9BA928 plus event/menu flags immediately. Finish makes phaseIdle, so restoring those flags cannot restart the queue.

verifiedBehavior.finding: Current0→requested1..6 queues exactly requested form. Current1..6→requested1..6 first queues0 then revalidates the fresh base actor and queues requested form, including same-form requests. Current1..6→0 reverts once.0→0 completes without a native call.
verifiedBehavior.strength: Source control-flow review plus direct review of exhaustive7x7 fake-memory test loop and per-step assertions.

verifiedBehavior.finding: Cancel126 executes before LiveScene gating and changes phase toIdle. It does not touch engine context/fiber, so Tick cannot emit another step. A later new request remains blocked by LiveScene while native transition is still pending.

AllowedThread rejects disabled bridge, missing shared state, wrong thread and stale/zero host heartbeat. DriveReset clears a pending queue; bridge ResetTrainerEffects calls it on first observed heartbeat expiry and DisableAll. Reconnection does not re-arm an Idle queue.

DWORD elapsed>=30000 is checked before pending context processing or another native call. The start timestamp is captured once and not restarted for the second step; the limit covers the entire request.
Queue binds scene-ready state, heap, field scheduler, actor scheduler and ten-byte room target. Pending transition or observed identity mismatch permanently finishes queue.

After pending context is zero, Tick requires a nonzero actor different from the previous source, expected actor and save form, valid current global actor/status backlinks, active-list membership, rebuild data and native cleanup lockbit2 clear.

40D000 allocates the replacement before deleting the old actor. Context source remains the old actor while the new actor is local; this supports sourceActor inequality. Clearing native context alone is insufficient, because cleanup/cancel can clear it too.
NativeQueueFailed,SafetyRejected,SceneChanged,HostExpired,TimedOut andCancelled all setIdle; no later Tick retry is scheduled.
Capabilities122..127 are published.122/123/126 are action handlers and124/125/127 are target/phase/outcome readouts.
TrainerBridge calls MakeTrainerContext again immediately after DriveTick before subsequent domains and snapshots, avoiding reuse after second-step activation.

limitations: Exact ABA: context, task and actor addresses plus compared fields can theoretically be destroyed and reused identically between two sampled frames. No native monotonic generation token was found or claimed. The guards detect observed replacements, not all mathematically possible unobserved ABA sequences.
Cancellation suppresses future trainer steps; an already-started native operation is intentionally allowed to complete. No rollback or engine-fiber cancellation is promised.
Static and synthetic checks do not execute the game's allocation, fiber resource-loading, renderer or actor replacement code; native out-of-memory and external mod behavior remain outside the proof.
A scene change entirely between samples with every captured identity reused identically has the same observation limit; normal ready/transition and scheduler/heap changes are checked.

tests.status: Frozen test source reviewed; author executed first run. Root owns the subsequent centralized release run.

authorRun.evidence: Author confirmation with exact frozen source/test hashes in team message; no independent execution by this reviewer.

coverage: 49 current0..6→requested0..6 pairs, including all6 same-form pairs, checking first call actor/form, pending wait, fresh base for second call, resulting form and no retry.
Zero gauge, locked form and missing allies do not invoke normal Drive restrictions; fixture checks no trainer unlock/grant/gauge mutation.
Cancel in WaitingForBase,WaitingForForm andWaitingForRevert leaves native context untouched and prevents a later call after simulated completion.
Cancel works with unready scene; DisableAll/reset,zero/stale heartbeat,disabled bridge andwrong thread abort a WaitingForBase queue.
Total timeout, expired wrapped interval and valid short wrapped interval.
Heap/field scheduler/actor scheduler replacement, each room identity byte, transient pending transition, event/menu flags and sceneReady loss.
Foreign native context pointer and in-place source/form/task mutation.
Old actor with cleared context and updated Save form cannot advance.
Fresh base requires native lockbit2 clear, empty suspended-partner list and still-valid target resources.
Invalid completed form timer cannot be reported as success.
Initial native queue failure reports once without retry; malformed actor/status/resources/save/message data reject.
nonblockingGaps: NativeQueueFailed is exercised for first activation only, not when the second form activation after a successful Revert fails. Both use the same Begin→Finish path; adding a second-step case would make this explicit.

Cancel covers every phase, while reset/heartbeat/timeout are executed in WaitingForBase only. These common early exits precede phase-specific logic; testing final-step phase would strengthen the evidence.
Heartbeat recovery is not explicitly restored in AssertStopped after expiry. Source-level Idle return proves no revival; a fresh-heartbeat post-abort assertion would document it directly.
fixtureLimits: Fake native Begin callback emulates the context, task pointer, save form and lockbit; it does not execute40CE60 or any game code.

CompleteNative swaps/copies fixture actors and reuses the status object; old fixture memory remains readable. It proves current identity routing but does not emulate every allocator/fiber interleaving.

Fixture Writable delegates to Readable and DecodePacked uses the synthetic base+RVA layout; actual page protection and packed-pointer decoding remain covered by production helpers and separate integration evidence.
